6: import fs from 'node:fs'
7: import crypto from 'node:crypto'
8: import { type Request, type Response, type NextFunction } from 'express'
9: import { type UserModel } from '@juice-shop/models/user'
10: import expressJwt from 'express-jwt'
11: import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken'
12: import jws from 'jws'
13: import sanitizeHtmlLib from 'sanitize-html'
14: import sanitizeFilenameLib from 'sanitize-filename'
15: import * as utils from './utils'
16: 
17: // @ts-expect-error FIXME no typescript definitions for z85 :(
18: import * as z85 from 'z85'
19: 
20: export const publicKey = fs ? fs.readFileSync('encryptionkeys/jwt.pub', 'utf8') : 'placeholder-public-key'
21: <redacted-private-key>
22: 
23: interface ResponseWithUser {
24:   status?: string
25:   data: UserModel
26:   iat?: number
27:   exp?: number
28:   bid?: number
29: }
30: 
31: interface IAuthenticatedUsers {
32:   tokenMap: Record<string, ResponseWithUser>
33:   idMap: Record<string, string>
34:   put: (token: string, user: ResponseWithUser) => void
35:   get: (token?: string) => ResponseWithUser | undefined
36:   tokenOf: (user: UserModel) => string | undefined
37:   from: (req: Request) => ResponseWithUser | undefined
38:   updateFrom: (req: Request, user: ResponseWithUser) => any
39: }
40: 
41: export const hash = (data: string) => crypto.createHash('md5').update(data).digest('hex')
42: export const hmac = (data: string) => crypto.createHmac('sha256', 'pa4qacea4VK9t9nGv7yZtwmj').update(data).digest('hex')
43: 
44: export const cutOffPoisonNullByte = (str: string) => {
45:   const nullByte = '%00'
46:   if (str.includes(nullByte)) {
47:     return str.substring(0, str.indexOf(nullByte))
48:   }
49:   return str
50: }
51: 
52: export const isAuthorized = () => expressJwt(({ secret: publicKey }) as any)
53: export const denyAll = () => expressJwt({ secret: '<redacted>' + Math.random() } as any)
54: export const authorize = (user = {}) => jwt.sign(user, privateKey, { expiresIn: '6h', algorithm: 'RS256' })
55: export const verify = (token: string) => token ? (jws.verify as ((token: string, secret: string) => boolean))(token, publicKey) : false
56: export const decode = (token: string) => { return jws.decode(token)?.payload }
57: 
58: export const sanitizeHtml = (html: string) => sanitizeHtmlLib(html)
59: export const sanitizeLegacy = (input = '') => input.replace(/<(?:\w+)\W+?[\w]/gi, '')
60: export const sanitizeFilename = (filename: string) => sanitizeFilenameLib(filename)
61: export const sanitizeSecure = (html: string): string => {
62:   const sanitized = sanitizeHtml(html)
63:   if (sanitized === html) {
64:     return html
65:   } else {
66:     return sanitizeSecure(sanitized)
67:   }
68: }
69: 
70: export const authenticatedUsers: IAuthenticatedUsers = {
71:   tokenMap: {},
72:   idMap: {},
73:   put: function (token: string, user: ResponseWithUser) {
74:     this.tokenMap[token] = user
75:     this.idMap[user.data.id] = token
76:   },
77:   get: function (token?: string) {
78:     return token ? this.tokenMap[utils.unquote(token)] : undefined
79:   },
80:   tokenOf: function (user: UserModel) {
81:     return user ? this.idMap[user.id] : undefined
82:   },
83:   from: function (req: Request) {
84:     const token = utils.jwtFrom(req)
85:     return token ? this.get(token) : undefined
86:   },
87:   updateFrom: function (req: Request, user: ResponseWithUser) {
88:     const token = utils.jwtFrom(req)
89:     this.put(token, user)
90:   }
91: }
92: 
93: export const userEmailFrom = ({ headers }: any) => {
94:   return headers ? headers['x-user-email'] : undefined
95: }
96: 
97: export const generateCoupon = (discount: number, date = new Date()) => {
98:   const coupon = utils.toMMMYY(date) + '-' + discount
99:   return z85.encode(coupon)
100: }

5: import express, { type NextFunction, type Request, type Response } from 'express'
6: import path from 'node:path'
7: import config from 'config'
8: import { themes } from '../views/themes/themes'
9: import * as utils from '../lib/utils'
10: import { AllHtmlEntities as Entities } from 'html-entities'
11: 
12: import { SecurityQuestionModel } from '../models/securityQuestion'
13: import { PrivacyRequestModel } from '../models/privacyRequests'
14: import { SecurityAnswerModel } from '../models/securityAnswer'
15: import * as challengeUtils from '../lib/challengeUtils'
16: import { challenges } from '../data/datacache'
17: import * as security from '../lib/insecurity'
18: import { UserModel } from '../models/user'
19: 
20: const entities = new Entities()
21: 
22: const router = express.Router()
23: 
24: router.get('/', (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
25:   void (async () => {
26:     const loggedInUser = security.authenticatedUsers.get(req.cookies.token)
27:     if (!loggedInUser) {
28:       next(new Error('Blocked illegal activity by ' + req.socket.remoteAddress))
29:       return
30:     }
31:     const email = loggedInUser.data.email
32: 
33:     try {
34:       const answer = await SecurityAnswerModel.findOne({
35:         include: [{
36:           model: UserModel,
37:           where: { email }
38:         }]
39:       })
40:       if (answer == null) {
41:         throw new Error('No answer found!')
42:       }
43:       const question = await SecurityQuestionModel.findByPk(answer.SecurityQuestionId)
44:       if (question == null) {
45:         throw new Error('No question found!')
46:       }
47: 
48:       const themeKey = config.get<string>('application.theme') as keyof typeof themes
49:       const theme = themes[themeKey] || themes['bluegrey-lightgreen']
50:       res.render('dataErasureForm', {
51:         userEmail: email,
52:         securityQuestion: question.question,
53:         _title_: entities.encode(config.get<string>('application.name')),
54:         _favicon_: utils.extractFilename(config.get('application.favicon')),
55:         _bgColor_: theme.bgColor,
56:         _textColor_: theme.textColor,
57:         _navColor_: theme.navColor,
58:         _primLight_: theme.primLight,
59:         _primDark_: theme.primDark,
60:         _logo_: utils.extractFilename(config.get('application.logo'))
